items.snippet: 코스닥 시장이 장중 5% 넘는 급등세로 전일 급락분을 빠르게 되돌리고 있다.16일 한국거래소에 따르면 오후 12시 55분 23초 코스닥 시장에 매수 사이드카가 발동됐다. 같은 시각 코스닥150선물 가격이 전장보다 6% 이상 상승하고, 현물 지수가 전일 최종수치 대비 3% 이상 오른 상태가 1분 이상 지속된 영향이다.이날 국내 증시는 하루 만에 급반등했다. 간밤 미국 국채 금리가 예상보다 높은 물가 지표에도 반락하면서 투자 심리가 회복했다.장중에 전해진 케빈 워시 연방준비제도(연준·Fed) 의장의 발언도 증시에 상승 압력을 더했다.

items.snippet: 인텔이 서버용 중앙처리장치(CPU) 제온 프로세서의 인공지능(AI) 추론 성능을 극대화하는 '인텔 인퍼런스 마이크로서비스(Inference Microservice)'를 16일 공개했다.대규모 언어 모델(LLM)을 CPU에 맞춰 최적화 작업을 빠르게 처리하는 가상화(컨테이너) 소프트웨어다. 개방형(오픈소스) LLM 모델 실행에 필요한 코드, 엔진, 설정값 등 라이브러리를 담았다.소프트웨어가 구동되면 인텔 프로세서를 감지하고, 사전 검증해 조율한 최적의 AI 추론 설정값을 적용한다. AI 추론 최적화 전문 인력 의존도를 낮출 수 있다.

items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 대통령 취임 500일을 하루 앞둔 15일 직접 대통령비서실장 이임식과 임명식을 주재하며 2기 청와대를 본격적으로 가동했다. 이 대통령은 이날 임광현 신임 비서실장이 참석하는 첫 수석보좌관회의에서 “비서실장을 중심으로 언제든지 충분히 소통하고 토론하면서 어떻게 하면 청와대가 대한민국의 더 나은 미래를 위해 기여할 수 있을지를 함께 고민해 주시기 바란다”고 당부했다. 전날 비례대표 초선 의원, 국세청장 출신인 임 실장이 임명되면서 일각에서 경기·성남 라인의 영향력이 강해지는 것 아니냐는 우려가 나오자 비서실장 힘 싣기에 나섰다는 해석이 나온다. 임 실장은 이날 첫 비서실장 지시사항으로 “직급에 관계없이 국가와 민생을 위해 쓴소리를 전할 수 있도록 비서실장실에 익명 제안 창구를 설치하라”고 지시했다고 청와대 강유정 수석대변인이 서면...

items.title: 李, 김지용 청문회 하루만에 중수청장 임명 재가
items.snippet: 국회 행정안전위원회가 15일 김지용 중대범죄수사청(중수청)장 후보자(사진)에 대한 인사청문 경과보고서를 채택했다. 다만 국민의힘뿐 아니라 김 후보자에 대한 문제를 제기해온 더불어민주당 일부 의원들도 ‘부적격’ 의견을 냈다. 이재명 대통령은 이날 김 후보자 임명안을 재가했다고 청와대 강유정 수석대변인이 밝혔다. 국회 행안위는 이날 오후 전체회의를 열고 김 후보자에 대한 인사청문 경과보고서 채택의 건을 여야 합의로 의결했다. 행안위는 인사청문 경과보고서에 “검찰 출신인 후보자가 중수청장으로 임명될 경우 기존 검찰의 수사 관행이 답습되고 형사사법체계 개편의 취지가 훼손될 우려가 있다”는 부적격 의견과 “후보자가 관련 논란에 대한 판단 근거와 경위를 소명하였다는 점과 형사사법체계 개편의 취지를 존중하겠다는 의지를 표명했다”는 적격 의견을 함께 명시했...

items.title: “신앙인 소명으로 나눔 실천” 자소서로 합격… 건설근로자공제회 성남라인 이사장 논란
items.snippet: 이른바 ‘경기·성남 라인’ 인사들이 공공기관장으로 임명된 것을 둘러싼 논란이 확산되고 있다. 야권에서는 관련 경력이나 전문성이 부족한 ‘낙하산’ 인사들이 임명됐다고 비판하고 있다. 15일 국회 기후에너지환경노동위원회 소속 국민의힘 나경원 의원실이 건설근로자공제회로부터 제출받은 자료에 따르면 장건 이사장은 올해 4월 증권사 전무 출신 경쟁 후보를 제치고 이사장으로 임명됐다. 건설근로자공제회는 일용직 건설근로자를 위한 퇴직공제금 등을 운용하는 고용노동부 산하 기관인데, 시민단체 출신으로 기금 운용 경험이 없는 장 이사장이 임명된 것. 장 이사장은 자기소개서에서도 “기독신앙인으로서 ‘예수라면 어떻게 할 것인가’라는 소명을 갖고 삶의 현장에서 사회적 약자와 소외계층에 대한 섬김과 나눔을 통한 사랑을 실천하고자 애써 왔다”며 직무와 무관한 내용을 내세...

items.title: 與 “오세훈, 서울 집값 상승 남탓만” 吳 “정부 실거주 정책이 문제”
items.snippet: 15일 국회 행정안전위원회의 서울시 국정감사에서는 서울 집값 상승의 책임을 놓고 여당 의원들과 국민의힘 소속 오세훈 서울시장이 정면으로 맞붙었다. 더불어민주당 의원들은 “민간 공급에 치중한 나머지 공공주택 같은 서민이나 청년을 위한 정책 의지가 약한 것 아닌가”라며 서울시가 공공주택 공급에 소홀했다고 지적했다. 반면 오 시장은 “정부의 실거주 중심 정책이 전월세 공급을 위축시키고, 주택 매수 수요를 자극했다”고 맞섰다. 또 민주당은 한강버스 사업 과정의 리베이트 의혹을 제기하며 서울시장 5선에 성공해 야권의 차기 대선 주자로 부상한 오 시장을 몰아세웠다.● 與 “공공주택 공급 부진” vs 吳 “정부 정책 탓” 민주당 이상식 의원은 이날 서울시청에서 열린 국감에서 “올해 (서울시의 주택 공급) 목표가 거의 1만 호인데 9월 말 기준으로 5000...

items.title: 청해부대 임무 오만만까지 확대 추진
items.snippet: 정부가 올해 말 임무가 종료되는 청해부대의 파견을 연장하면서 임무 범위를 확대하는 방안을 추진 중인 것으로 알려졌다. 정부는 호르무즈 해협 파병과는 선을 긋고 있지만, 청해부대 임무 강화가 이재명 대통령이 언급해 온 ‘호르무즈 기여’ 방안이 될 수 있다는 관측이 나온다. 국방부는 15일 “최근 소말리아 아덴만 해역의 해적 활동이 예년 대비 급증하는 등 해당 지역의 안전 상황이 악화되고 있다”며 “청해부대 파견 동의안의 만료 이전, 연장 동의안 제출을 준비 중”이라고 밝혔다. 강신철 국방부 장관도 이날 국회 법제사법위원회의 국정감사에서 “청해부대의 임무, 파견 연장에 대한 부분들은 여러 가지로 다양하게 검토하고 있다”고 말했다. 일각에선 동의안에 아덴만 해역을 기본으로 하는 작전 범위를 호르무즈 해협 인근 오만만으로 넓히는 방안도 거론된다. 다...

items.title: 민주-국힘 지지율 오차범위내… 李정부 출범후 처음
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 지지율이 33%, 국민의힘이 28%로 집계되면서 양당 지지율 격차가 이재명 정부 출범 이후 처음으로 오차범위 안으로 좁혀졌다. 엠브레인퍼블릭, 케이스탯리서치, 코리아리서치, 한국리서치가 12일부터 14일까지 전국 성인 남녀 1000명을 조사해 15일 발표한 10월 셋째 주 전국지표조사(NBS, 무선전화 면접 100%, 95% 신뢰수준에 표본오차 ±3.1%포인트, 자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조)에 따르면 민주당 지지율은 33%, 국민의힘은 28%로 조사됐다. 직전 조사(10월 첫째 주)에선 민주당 35%, 국민의힘 25%였다. NBS 조사 기준으로 양당 격차가 오차범위 이내로 줄어든 것은 대선 직전이었던 지난해 5월 둘째 주 이후 처음이다. 민주당 지지율은 올 4월 넷째 주 48%로 이재명 정부 출범 이후 최...

items.title: 양향자 “전면 재선거” 장동혁 “흔드니 좋나”… 국힘 최고위원회 충돌
items.snippet: 국민의힘 경기 용인갑 조직위원장 선거 과정에서 자동응답(ARS) 전화가 일부 당원들에게 발신되지 않은 것과 관련해 당 지도부와 당사자인 양향자 최고위원이 공개석상에서 충돌했다. 비당권파인 양 최고위원이 “‘올공(올림픽공원) 원칙’을 대입해 전체 선거에 대한 전수조사와 전면 재선거가 필요하다”고 주장하자 당권파가 “당 시스템을 무너뜨리고 있다”며 설전을 벌인 것. 경기 용인갑 경선에서 패배한 양 최고위원은 15일 최고위에서 “ARS 경선에서는 전화 오는 절차가 곧 투표용지인데, ARS 전화가 오지 않았다는 (당원들의) 제보가 지금도 오고 있다”고 했다. 그러자 정희용 사무총장은 “당의 시스템을 무력화하는 발언”이라며 공개적으로 항의했다. 이어진 비공개 최고위에서도 장동혁 대표는 “부정선거로 싸우고 있는 당 대표까지 싸울 자격을 없게 만들고 당...

items.title: “수공, 尹정부때 외교부 협의 않고 우크라 재건 추진”
items.snippet: 한국수자원공사가 윤석열 정부 시절 우크라이나 재건 사업을 외교당국과 협의하지 않고 일방적으로 추진한 것으로 나타났다. 당시 외교당국은 러시아와의 관계를 고려해 우크라이나에 대한 지원에 부정적이었다. 15일 김태선 더불어민주당 의원실이 기후에너지환경부에서 받은 수자원공사 특정감사 보고서에 따르면 수공은 2024년 2월 우크라이나 트루스카베츠에 식수 공급 시설을 지원하는 사업을 외교부와 협의하지 않고 진행했다. 국제개발협력기본법에 따르면 국제개발협력 사업을 추진하는 기관은 외교부를 통해 재외 공관과 협의해야 한다. 기후부는 지난해 말 수공에 대한 감사에 착수해 올 2월 보고서를 내놨다. 윤 전 대통령은 2023년 7월 폴란드에서 열린 ‘우크라이나 재건 협력 기업 간담회’에 참석해 민관 협력을 통한 재건사업 참여를 지원하겠다고 밝혔다. 같은 해 1...

items.title: 가게 직원과 시비, 옆집 문소리에… 흉기 든 ‘그놈들’
items.snippet: 13일 인천 남동구의 대형 상가에서 흉기 난동을 벌인 살인미수 전과자 최모 씨(59)는 정신 질환 치료 중 범행을 저질렀다. 공공장소에서 흉기를 들고 다니다 재판에 넘겨진 이들 중 상당수가 최 씨처럼 △분노 표출 △정신질환 △전과 등 위험 요소를 보인 것으로 나타났다. 특히 공공장소 흉기 소지가 자칫 이상동기 범죄로 이어질 가능성도 커 청와대가 15일 관계부처 합동 회의를 열고 대책 마련에 나섰다. 살인미수죄로 복역한 뒤 전자발찌를 차고 있던 최 씨는 지난달 병원 치료에 불만을 표하며 거리에서 흉기를 꺼내 이달 초 공공장소 흉기 소지 혐의로 입건됐다. 그는 알코올 중독 등 정신질환으로 치료받는 상태였다. 경찰은 위험성이 큰 흉기 소지자는 구속이나 입원 등 후속 조치를 하는데, 최 씨는 이 위험성 평가를 받지 않았다. 공공장소 흉기소지죄로 올해...

items.title: 특검, 이달 구속만료 김건희 추가 영장 요청

items.title: Extended strange metal and superconductivity in partially filled moiré Hubbard bands
items.abstract: Moiré semiconductors provide a physical realization of the Hubbard model. Bandwidth-tuned Mott transitions and complex phase diagrams mimicking those of high-temperature superconductors have been demonstrated near a weak Mott insulating state at half-band-filling. The platform also provides an opportunity to explore the physics of a partially filled Hubbard band at doping densities far away from the Mott insulator, a regime that has remained largely unexplored. Here we report the emergence of an extended strange metal (ESM), in both doping density and twist angle, in a partially filled Hubbard band of twisted bilayer WSe2. The ESM is in the clean limit, persists down to 100mK, and spans over multiple symmetry-breaking ground states; it also appears only at small twist angles, where electronic correlations are strong. These observations distinguish the state from the reported strange meta...

items.title: Energetics of Fault-Tolerant Spin-Qubit Quantum Computation
items.abstract: Semiconductor spin qubits offer a promising route to compact and scalable quantum computers, combining long coherence times in isotopically purified silicon with compatibility with semiconductor manufacturing. Beyond computational speedup, their energy efficiency is an important consideration for future large-scale systems. We evaluate the power and energy requirements of a Loss-DiVincenzo spin-qubit quantum computer by analyzing the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) and benchmarking it against the classical Fast Fourier Transform (FFT). We develop a detailed energy budget, identifying cryogenic cooling as the dominant baseline contribution before quantum error correction (QEC). The comparison between the QFT and the classical FFT reveals that, for any quantum workload operating under a polynomially bounded sampling regime, the crossover in energy consumption occurs at smaller problem size...

items.snippet: 과거 검찰의 수사권 남용 의혹을 조사 중인 검찰인권존중미래위원회(검찰미래위) 진상조사단이 15일 이재명 대통령이 기소된 위례 신도시 개발 비리와 서해 공무원 피격, 문재인 정부 부동산 통계 조작 등 3건에 대한 검찰 수사에는 문제가 없었다고 결론 내렸다. 하지만 검찰미래위는 조사단에 추가 조사를 요구한 것으로 확인됐다. 법조계에서는 “검찰미래위가 추가 조사를 해서라도 검찰 수사의 문제점을 찾으려는 것 같다”는 반응이 나왔다.

items.title: 선선한 가을 날씨… 축제 즐기기 딱 좋네
items.snippet: 10월은 축제의 계절이다. 22일 경남 사천에선 ‘2026 사천 에어쇼’가 막을 올린다. 공군 특수 비행팀 ‘블랙이글스’가 곡예 비행을 선보인다. 국산 초음속 전투기 KF-21, 지대공 미사일 천궁 등 최신 무기도 볼 수 있다. 우주항공방위산업전도 함께 열린다. 행사는 25일까지다. 경북 칠곡에선 15일 ‘칠곡 낙동강 평화 축제’가 개막했다. 올해 주제는 ‘소년, 소년병이 되다’다. 군복을 입고 부교(浮橋)를 건너는 등 소년병 체험을 할 수 있다. 행사는 18일까지 이어진다.

items.title: 리디아 고·김주형·최예림…‘73승 名코치’가 밝힌 비결
items.snippet: 고진영을 여자 골프 세계 1위로 만들었고, 리디아 고(뉴질랜드)와는 올림픽 금메달을 합작했다. 깊은 부진에 빠져 있던 김주형이 2년 9개월 만에 PGA(미 프로골프) 투어 우승컵을 들고 최근 아시안게임 금메달까지 거머쥔 데에도 그의 도움을 빼놓을 수 없다. 국내 최고의 골프 교습가로 꼽히는 이시우(45) 코치다.

items.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 disappears from Micro Center amid rumors of a production halt
items.snippet: Micro Center has reclassified Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics cards as 'Not Carried,' and almost all units are out of stock at its stores.

items.title: “내가 벌써 백살이라니? 하하”… 신영균은 여전히 패기 넘쳤다
items.snippet: 15일 서울 고덕동에 대낮부터 ‘별’들이 쏟아졌다. 이정재, 이영애, 이재, 박찬욱, 김무열 등 한류 스타를 비롯해 임권택, 박근형, 박정자, 손숙, 고은아, 정혜선, 백일섭, 유인촌, 유동근, 전인화, 박상원, 최명길, 인순이, 배창호, 김수철, 박찬호, 정준호 등 문화예술계 명사 100여 명이 운집했다. 영화계 ‘큰별’이자 어른인 신영균 선생의 백수(白壽)를 축하하기 위해서다.

items.title: [플라자] 서울총장포럼·관훈클럽 업무협약 체결
items.snippet: 서울총장포럼과 관훈클럽은 15일 대학 교육과 현장 저널리즘의 연계를 강화하기 위한 업무협약(MOU)을 체결했다. 이에 따라 내년부터 관훈클럽 회원들이 서울총장포럼 소속 39개 대학에서 자신의 전문 분야와 취재 경험을 살려 정규 강의나 특강을 할 수 있는 시스템이 마련된다.

items.title: 방미통위, KBS 이사 2명 임명 제청… 방문진·EBS 이사도 각 2명 임명
items.snippet: 방송미디어통신위원회(방미통위)는 15일 제42차 전체 회의에서 이강덕 관훈클럽정신영기금 이사장과 장한식 전 KBS비즈니스 사장을 한국방송공사(KBS) 이사로 대통령에게 임명 제청하기로 했다. 또 오정환 전 공정언론국민연대 공동대표와 정재욱 법무법인 태원 변호사를 방송문화진흥회(방문진) 이사로, 박기완 전 KBS 원주방송국장과 조한제 전 벡스코 상임감사를 EBS 이사로 임명하기로 했다. 6명 모두 국민의힘 추천 인사다. 방미통위는 아울러 EBS 이사회가 임명 제청한 김장환 전 KBS 대구방송총국장을 EBS 감사로 임명하기로 의결했다. 방문진·EBS 이사와 EBS 감사의 임명일은 오는 19일이다.

items.snippet: ▲ 신순녀 별세, 박금선 · 박옥선 · 박광재 세계일보 편집위원· 박명옥 · 박정재 모친상=15일5시 경기 광명성애병원, 발인 17일5시30분, (02)2684-4444 ▲ 이경아 별세, 김성하 한국오라클 사장· 김성윤 아이포트폴리오 대표 모친상, 고미진 주한캐나다대사관 수석공보관· 오화진 Ok북클럽 대표 시모상=15일4시46분 서울아산병원, 발인 17일5시, (02)3010-2000

items.title: 황선우, 서울대 의대에 2억원
items.snippet: 황선우 산학연 종합센터장은 16일 2026학년도 서울대 의대 대학 발전 기금 2억원 전달식을 갖는다. 황 센터장은 매년 서울대 의대에 발전 기금을 전달해 오고 있다.

items.title: Tears, hugs and continued fight for housing: Madrid's Puerta del Sol after two weeks
items.snippet: After more than two weeks of camping in Puerta del Sol, demonstrators are battling exhaustion and the challenges of living outdoors, while solidarity keeps the protest alive and Madrid's regional government continues to call for their eviction.

items.title: [알립니다] 우리 아이 출생 소식 액자에 담아 간직하세요
items.snippet: 조선일보에 실린 아기 출생 소식, 본인이나 지인의 인터뷰·사진 기사를 영원히 추억으로 간직하세요. 조선일보는 독자가 원하는 신문 지면을 그대로 고급 액자에 담아 드리는 ‘조선일보 리프린트’ 서비스를 합니다. 매주 ‘아이가 행복입니다’ 지면에 소개된 한 가족을 추첨해 리프린트를 선물로 드립니다. 지난 2일 ‘우리 아기가 태어났어요’ 코너에 실린 김태리 양이 이번 주 주인공입니다. 자세한 내용은 홈페이지(reprint.chosun.com)에서 확인할 수 있습니다.

items.title: 직원 지방 이사에… 재택근무 허용하고 현지 사무실 마련했죠
items.snippet: 한 살 아이를 키우는 김승희 화정엔지니어링 경영기획부 과장은 지난 4월 1년간의 육아휴직을 마치고 복직했다. 복직과 동시에 육아기 근로시간 단축을 신청했지만, 아이가 자주 아파 출근하기 어려운 날도 있었다. 그럴 때마다 회사는 재택근무를 허용했다. 김 과장은 “단축 근무 중에도 아이가 아프면 흔쾌히 재택근무를 허용해줘 육아와 일을 병행하는 데 큰 도움이 됐다”고 했다. 휴직 전 맡았던 업무도 그대로 이어가고 있다.

items.title: [우리 아기가 태어났어요] 이은빈·홍지명 아들 이준 외
items.snippet: 온 가족에게 기쁨을 안겨 준 아기의 탄생을 알려주세요. 홈페이지 주소 입력창에 아가야안녕.com이라고 입력하면 됩니다. 매일유업 육아 정보 사이트 매일아이(maeili.com)를 통해서도 접속할 수 있습니다. 추첨을 통해 출산 소식과 사진이 지면에 실린 가족에게는 ①케이크 구매권 ②엄마와 아이를 위한 매일두 포인트 3만원 ③출산 소식을 생일 날짜 본지 1면에 담은 PDF 파일 ④조선일보 1개월 무료 구독권을 드립니다. 당첨자 중 한 가족을 선정하여 해당 지면을 고급 프레임에 담아 제공하는 조선일보 리프린트도 제작해 드립니다. 홈페이지에서는 균형 영양식 메디웰 2만원 할인 혜택도 드리고 있습니다.

“관세청, 수사 적법성 등 점검할 인력-제도 부족”
items.snippet: 검사의 수사지휘권이 사라진 가운데 관세청이 자체적으로 수사 절차의 적법성을 판단하고 수사 과정의 문제점을 점검할 인력과 제도가 부족하다는 지적이 나왔다. 15일 정부대전청사에서 열린 국회 재정경제기획위원회 국정감사에서 국민의힘 윤영석 의원은 관세청 특별사법경찰(특사경) 730명의 수사를 지원하는 변호사가 4명에 불과하다고 지적했다. 윤 의원은 특사경의 40% 이상이 소속 부서에서 근무한 지 2년이 채 되지 않아 수사 경험이 부족할 수 있다는 우려도 제기했다. 경험이 부족한 수사관들이 압수수색 등 강제수사 과정에서 법적 절차를 잘못 밟으면 확보한 증거를 재판에서 사용하지 못할 수 있다는 것이다. 이에 대해 이종욱 관세청장은 전체 수사 경력은 평균 5년 수준이라고 해명했다. 이 청장은 “수사 심사과 또는 수사 심의과를 본부세관에 설치하는 방안을...

items.title: ‘한발 2000원’ 한화 천광, 드론 3대 100% 요격
items.snippet: 한화시스템이 제작한 세계 최초 레이저 대(對)드론 요격 체계가 시연 행사에서 100% 명중률을 기록하며 실전 성능을 입증했다. 15일 한화시스템에 따르면 세계 최초의 레이저 대공 무기 ‘천광’과 ‘전투차량 탑재형 고에너지 레이저포’가 14일 육군 주관으로 열린 전투수행훈련에서 표적 드론 3대를 모두 요격하면서 타격률 100%를 기록했다. 천광은 국방과학연구소(ADD)가 개발하고 한화시스템에서 시제 업체로 참여했고, 레이저포는 국방기술진흥연구소 관리하에 한화시스템이 개발한 레이저 무기체계다. 레이저를 실전 대공 방어에 실제로 활용하는 것은 이번이 처음이다. 특히 이들 무기체계는 탄약 보급이 필요 없어 전력만 공급되면 24시간 운용이 가능하다고 한화시스템 측은 설명했다. 또 한 번 발사하는 데 드는 비용이 약 2000원 수준으로 저가 드론 공세에...

items.snippet: 서울디자인재단은 10월 14~18일 동대문디자인플라자(DDP)에서 여는 ‘DDP 디자인 페어’에서 대학 협업 프로그램을 통해 마련한 20개 부스를 선보인다. 대학생 디자이너들이 기업이 제시한 실제 과제를 바탕으로 아이디어를 구체화하고, 전문가의 멘토링과 피드백을 거쳐 기획부터 제작, 전시까지 진행하는 것이다. 서울디자인재단은 ‘디자인 산업 육성과 디자인 문화 확산을 통해 서울 시민 삶의 질을 높인다’는 목표로 운영되고 있다. 지난 2024년부터 차강희(64·사진) 대표이사가 서울디자인재단을 이끌고 있다. 차 대표는 30여 년간 산업 디자이너로 활동한 디자인 전문가다. LG전자 디자인연구소장으로 근무하면서 초콜릿폰, 프라다폰, 올레드(OLED) TV, 노트북 그램(gram) 같은 디자인 개발을 주도했다. 이후 홍익대 산업미술대학원 산업디자인 교...

items.title: 배우고, 경험하고, 소통하고… “우리 아이디어는 현실이 된다”
items.snippet: 서울디자인재단(대표이사 차강희)은 디자인 전공 대학생에게 산업 현장의 실무 경험과 전시 기회를 제공해 이들의 성장을 지원하는 ‘대학 협업 프로그램’을 운영하고 있다. 재단은 오는 14~18일 서울 동대문디자인플라자(DDP) 아트홀에서 ‘2026 DDP디자인페어’ 영디자이너(Young Designer) 특별관을 열고, 대학 협업 프로그램에 참여한 20개 팀의 부스를 꾸렸다. 디자인 전공 대학생 90여 명이 기업과 협업해 만든 디자인 작품을 공개한다.

items.title: Low magnon damping of a EuSe film down to millikelvin temperatures
items.abstract: The rapid development of quantum magnonics over the past decade has created a demand for magnetic materials that keep their magnon losses low at millikelvin temperatures and add functionality beyond that of the established iron garnets and ferromagnetic metals. The europium chalcogenides are natural candidates $-$ they are magnetic semiconductors whose moment of $7\,μ_{\mathrm{B}}$ per Eu$^{2+}$ ion stems from a half-filled $4f$ shell with zero orbital momentum, so that spin-orbit coupling and intrinsic damping are expected to be weak. Here we characterize an epitaxial film of the metamagnet EuSe on diamagnetic BaF$_2$ by magnetometry and broadband ferromagnetic resonance from 10 K down to 30 mK. Novel high-pressure silicon allotrope with quartz topology from first principles
items.abstract: A novel silicon allotrope, qtz Si, with quartz topology is proposed and investigated alongside four known allotropes (dia Si-I, lon Si-IV, bsn Si-II, and gsi Si-III) using first-principles density functional theory. qtz Si is found to exhibit the smallest atom-averaged volume (18.06 A3), highest density (2.582 g/cm3), highest bulk modulus (98 GPa), and highest maximum phonon frequency (16 THz) among the five, while showing the lowest shear modulus (37 GPa). All five allotropes are confirmed to satisfy the Born stability criteria and to display positive phonon frequencies throughout the Brillouin zone, i.e., they are mechanically and dynamically stable. Electronic structure calculations show that qtz Si is a semimetal with a vanishing gap, whereas dia Si and lon Si are semiconductors, and bsn and gsi allotropes are weakly metallic. items.snippet: 오세훈 서울시장이 15일 용산공원 부지 일부에 주택을 공급하는 정부 계획에 대해 “특별법을 정면으로 거스르는 조치”라며 재차 반대 입장을 밝혔다. 전·월세 가격 상승과 매매 수요 증가는 정부의 실거주 중심 부동산 정책 때문이라고도 주장했다. 15일 국회 행정안전위원회의 서울시 국정감사에 참석한 오 시장은 “용산공원 본체 부지, 특히 장교 숙소나 군인 아파트 부지를 아파트로 개발하겠다는 정부 계획은 용산공원특별법을 정면으로 거스르는 조치”라며 “국민적 공감대가 형성된 상태에서 용산공원 특별법이 제정됐고, 그 법에 의하면 본체 부지를 일부라도 다른 용도로 전용하는 경우에는 법 개정이 필요하다”고 말했다.

items.title: Enabling large language model agents for high-fidelity many-body perturbation theory calculations
items.abstract: Many-body perturbation theory (MBPT) methods, including the GW approximation, the GW plus Bethe-Salpeter equation (GW-BSE) method, and GW perturbation theory (GWPT), among others, provide accurate first-principles descriptions of excited-state properties and multiparticle interactions of materials. However, their use remains limited due to complex multi-software workflows, interdependent physical parameters, and substantial theoretical expertise. Large language model (LLM) agents, which couple a language model to software tools, show potential in automating computational tasks, but MBPT remains an unaddressed challenge. We show that LLM agents tested in our work, including frontier models such as Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5, do not reliably construct MBPT workflows in one attempt, suggesting that correct setup requires expert knowledge and consistency that current models lack. items.title: Robust Data-Driven Controller Synthesis from Sampled and Uncertain Frequency Response Estimates using Integral Quadratic Constraints
items.abstract: In this paper, we develop a novel MIMO controller synthesis method that relies solely on frequency-domain data of discrete-time systems. The approach is based on an iterative design procedure using \emph{integral quadratic constraints} (IQCs). It generalizes existing data-driven methods that approximate semi-infinite IQC conditions by enforcing them on a finite set of measured frequency points. Such approximations do not provide guarantees on the continuous frequency axis and may fail to capture inter-frequency behavior. We address this limitation by formulating a convex optimization problem that preserves robustness guarantees over the entire frequency range. In particular, the proposed method explicitly accounts for inter-frequency behavior of both plant and controller, leading to certified robust stability and performance. The effectiveness and computational efficiency of the approach...

items.title: The Reciprocal tau-Cell: A Log-Domain Circuit for On-Chip Learning
items.abstract: Training hardware by gradient descent requires a gradient to be computed using a separate backwards pass. If a circuit is reciprocal, meaning every connection is symmetric, the backward pass is the same network run a second time with the error as its input. The reciprocal tau-cell, a weak-inversion log-domain circuit, makes this practical in standard CMOS. Each cell is a current-mode leaky integrator with a built-in ReLU; each connection is two transistors whose signed strength is a ratio of bias currents. The equilibrium of the network is the solution to a convex program, and latching the cells that are off will hardware linearise the circuit, making its second run exactly linear. Transistor-level SKY130 simulations show that the second run gives the gradient within 1.9%; that hardware linearisation permits large, noise-robust error signals; that a 13-cell network learns the Iris data s...

items.title: On-sky performance and prospects of near-infrared CMOS detectors in exoplanet detection: first year of SPIRIT
items.abstract: Ultracool dwarfs are promising targets for detecting and characterising temperate terrestrial exoplanets. Their flux peaks in the near-infrared, beyond the wavelength cut-off of the silicon-based CCDs used by ground-based surveys dedicated to observing them, such as SPECULOOS. We present the on-sky performance of SPIRIT (SPeculoos InfraRed Imager for Transits), an InGaAs CMOS detector on the Callisto telescope at the SPECULOOS Southern Observatory, during its first year of operation, from mid-2022 to 2023. We use 328 visits of 73 targets to optimise our CMOS-specific reduction process, including our approach to glow effects and bad-pixel handling. We find the measured precision to be consistent with our theoretical noise model, achieving sub-part-per-thousand precision under good observing conditions across targets spanning $J$-band magnitudes of 10--13. items.title: CAFE: Conducting-Cell-Aware Adaptive Differential Encoding for Robust DNN Inference in FeFET-Based Compute-in-Memory
items.abstract: Ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET)-based compute-in-memory (CIM) promises energy-efficient deep neural network (DNN) inference, but device variation can severely degrade bit-sliced CIM accuracy. Prior works either rely on hardware modifications or treat such variation as generic noise, overlooking a key FeFET asymmetry: negligible off-state leakage makes errors dominated by conducting on-state cells. This asymmetry is amplified by two's-complement sign extension, which maps small negative values to high-significance bit slices and magnifies their errors during shift-and-add reconstruction. In this paper, we propose CAFE, a conducting-cell-aware adaptive differential encoding framework built upon this FeFET-specific asymmetry. items.abstract: Semiconductor moiré superlattices, owing to strongly bound excitons and pronounced electronic correlation, have emerged as an intriguing solid platform for exploring correlated bosonic phenomena, where the moiré potential landscape plays a central role. Hydrostatic pressure allows continuous, in-situ tuning of this landscape, but remains underexplored because of experimental challenges. Here we integrate a diamond anvil pressure cell with high quality dual gated WSe2/WS2 twisted bilayers and perform cryogenic optical spectroscopy. We observe distinct pressure evolutions of moiré intralayer excitons, which reveal drastic modulation of the excitonic moiré-potential landscape captured by a continuum model and suggest the capability of engineering the exciton-band topology. items.title: Single anyons and anyon binding in a quantum Hall dot
items.abstract: Anyons are particles with quantized fractional statistics. In theory, a single anyon can be stabilized as a localized fractional charge within the bulk of a topologically ordered two-dimensional insulator. However, experiments to date have focused on probing anyons in structures in which many anyonic excitations coexist and interact. Here, we demonstrate the trapping of a single anyon in a device consisting of a graphene-based quantum point contact with an embedded tunable quantum Hall dot. Benchmarking our device at v = 1, we demonstrate backscattering between Fermi liquid edge states mediated by the whole-electron Coulomb blockade of the dot. The cleanliness and control available in our device allow depletion of the dot to the last quasihole, and we observe spin blockade for transitions to the opposite-spin Landau level. We test this understanding with systematic measurements and first-principles calculations of the photon-energy dependence of ultrafast-laser-driven coherent phonon generation in tellurium, using excitation wavelengths around the electronic band gap. We observe that, contrary to the expectations of models assuming a thermalized carrier population, the coherent amplitude of the fully symmetric $A_1$ mode changes only weakly when tuning wavelength across the band gap. items.title: Tellurium trioxide as an n-type wide-gap semiconductor with ultrahigh work functions from first principles
items.abstract: The exploration of next-generation wide-gap semiconductors with extreme work functions is highly desirable for the continued advancement of electronic and optoelectronic devices. By using first principles calculations, we show that \b{eta}-TeO3, with a wide band gap exceeding 3 eV, emerges as a promising n-type semiconductor exhibiting ultrahigh work functions of up to ~8 eV. Intentionally or unintentionally incorporated interstitial H, Li, Na, Cu, Mg, and Zn impurities and substitutional F impurities are identified as shallow donors, whereas O vacancies act as minor carrier-compensating defects that locally trap electrons at neighbouring Te sites. The work function is evaluated across a series of low-index nonpolar surfaces. The presence of ordered O vacancies is energetically favoured on these surfaces and tends to reduce the corresponding work functions. These findings underscore the...

items.title: Thermal stability and structural ordering of thick Co$_2$MnAl films grown on MgO and Si substrates
items.abstract: While most studies on Co$2$MnAl (CMA) focus on the ultrathin regime for spintronic junctions, applications scaling with magnetic volume--such as Anomalous Nernst Effect (ANE) energy harvesters, integrated power inductors, and magnetic MEMS--require significantly thicker films. In this work, 750 nm thick CMA films were grown on MgO (001) and Si substrates to establish a roadmap for their thermal integration. Structural analysis reveals that B2 ordering is optimized on MgO at 600 $^\circ$C, which is important for functional devices. In contrast, samples on Si substrates exhibit a disorder transition toward the A2 phase, closely linked to diffusion-driven degradation processes. items.title: Theory of deeply subwavelength electromagnetic structuring of semiconductors due to thermal-ionization instability
items.abstract: We develop a theory of ionization-assisted instability that governs the reflection of intense electromagnetic pulses from a semiconductor surface. Local overheating of the material increases the free-carrier density and conductivity, which in turn enhances the absorption of the incident radiation and further amplifies local heating and avalanche ionization. At high pump repetition rates, the overheating accumulates from pulse to pulse, leading to a gradual rise of the local material temperature and free carrier density - a positive feedback loop that drives thermal runaway. However, this effect competes with diffraction of the pump field on the emerging perturbation of the dielectric permittivity or on the surface relief, which reduces the local electric field amplitude in the overheated regions, thus providing negative feedback. items.title: Mixed Precision Scaling Laws for Quantized Pretraining
items.abstract: Since scaling laws were introduced for modern LLMs (Kaplan et al., 2020), several works have extended them to account for quantization, tracking the emerging low-precision data types supported on AI accelerators. We develop a more accurate scaling law for quantized pretraining with mixed precision across the forward and backward passes, grounded in optimization theory and validated empirically. Our formulation separates the effects of quantization on model capacity and on optimization efficiency, and explicitly models the persistent optimization error from forward and backward quantization identified through convergence analysis. To select the regimes for fitting and evaluating our law, we first decompose existing 4-bit training recipes into their forward and backward components, isolating those that most affect loss. items.title: First-Principles Calculations of the Electron-Hole-Pair Creation Energy in Semiconductors and Dielectrics
items.abstract: We present first-principles calculations of the electron-hole-pair creation energy in semiconductors and dielectrics, focusing in particular on AlN, 3C-SiC, 4H-SiC, Si, and SiO2. We have employed density functional theory (DFT) to calculate the band structure, density-functional perturbation theory to obtain the phonon dispersion, and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) to calculate the electron energy loss function (via the dielectric function). We performed full-band Monte Carlo simulations of electron thermalization for energies up to ~100 eV and calculated the average energy required to excite an electron-hole pair. items.abstract: Thermodynamic computing lets stochastic physical dynamics carry out a computation and reads out the result as a time average. Recently, thermodynamic computing has been demonstrated on several hardware platforms, including digital CMOS circuits based on stochastic computing. Superconducting single-flux-quantum (SFQ) logic offers very high clock rates and very low switching energy, but it heavily penalizes state, memory, fan-out, and feedback, i.e., exactly the per-neuron accumulators on which such designs rely. We therefore realize thermodynamic computing in SFQ logic through a co-design of a generative model and its circuit in which the datapath holds no state at all. items.title: The Era of Vibe Tapeout: Dark Age or Golden Age for Analog Circuit Design?
items.abstract: LLM agents now write their own schematic and layout generators, run EDA tools, read the results, and fix the design. This "vibe tapeout" is becoming practical for analog circuits as well. This paper measures how far it has come in two settings. items.title: TileCas: Cascading Kernel Development Across Programming Abstractions
items.abstract: Programming abstractions have traditionally been designed for humans, but code generation is increasingly performed by models and autonomous agents. We investigate abstractions for machine-driven programming through GPU and AI-accelerator kernel generation. High-level domain-specific languages (DSLs) simplify search by delegating implementation details to compilers, while lower-level representations provide finer-grained control at the cost of a larger and more complex search space. In this paper, we present TileCas, a unified, pluggable interface that enables coding agents to develop kernels across multiple editable abstraction levels. items.abstract: Bismuth oxyselenide (Bi2O2Se) has emerged as a leading semiconductor candidate for next-generation electronics and quantum phenomena research. However, its strong ionic interlayer bonding of Se layers fundamentally restricts the full potential of this otherwise promising quasi-two-dimensional (2D) material. In this work, we demonstrate chlorine substitution as an effective strategy to introduce van der Waals gaps and modify the electronic structure of the system. Through comprehensive transport and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) measurements on Bi6O6Se2Cl2 single crystal, an optimal Cl-doping compound, we show that the key electronic features, including indirect band gap, high electron mobility, and carrier effective mass, are well preserved, while the 2D character of the system is sufficiently enhanced. items.title: Revealing New Leakage Paths in GAAFETs using Predictive First-Principles Simulations
items.abstract: Gate-All-Around Field-Effect Transistors (GAAFETs) are emerging as successors to Fin Field-Effect Transistors (FinFETs) and are central to continued scaling at advanced semiconductor nodes. Despite their improved electrostatic control, recent measurements show that the drain current in GAAFETs deviates strongly from thermionic behavior at negative gate voltages, increasing as the gate voltage becomes more negative. This leakage has been attributed to direct gate-drain tunneling through the high-$k$ dielectric, enhanced by drain-induced dielectric barrier lowering (DIDBL). Here, we use predictive, charge-self-consistent Non-Equilibrium Green Function (NEGF) simulations based on the Contact Block Reduction (CBR) method to spatially resolve this leakage pathway in GAAFETs. items.abstract: Emerging dataflow accelerators offer exceptional energy efficiency and throughput for machine learning workloads, yet remain largely opaque to developers for performance analysis. Unlike CPUs and GPUs, where instrumentation frameworks enable fine-grained introspection, dataflow hardware exposes little information. This lack of transparency limits the ability of compiler engineers, system designers, and application developers to analyze, tune, or debug accelerator behavior. In this paper, we introduce DFIT (DataFlow Accelerator Instrumentation Tool), an instrumentation framework designed specifically for dataflow architectures. DFIT directly instruments operations, regions, and compiler transformations at the graph IR and backend-lowering stages using semantic program representation. items.abstract: Chiral anomaly in topological materials manifests as negative longitudinal magnetoresistance, yet the tunability and evolution of this effect remain elusive. Here we show that doped tellurium serves as a versatile platform to realize a giant negative longitudinal magnetoresistance that is highly tunable via the Fermi level and magnetic field. By moving the Fermi level towards the Weyl point, we observe a pronounced enhancement of negative magnetoresistance, which arises from chiral anomaly and robustly persists up to ambient temperature. items.title: Spatiotemporal computing for temporal nonlinear tasks using few-mode fiber and SOA nonlinearity
items.abstract: Step-index few-mode fibers (FMFs) provide a compact passive platform for high-speed photonic information processing by exploiting modal dispersion to map temporal inputs into spatiotemporal representations with short-term memory. In previous studies, we have demonstrated linear classification tasks with such FMFs, such as ultrafast multibit header recognition. Here, we extend the computational capability of such architectures towards solving nonlinear tasks by introducing an optical nonlinearity at the output of the dispersive medium. The FMF output is processed through parallel direct and nonlinear branches, with the latter implemented using a nonlinear semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA). We experimentally evaluate the architecture at 28.5 Gb/s on two delayed XOR and higher-order parity tasks. items.title: Effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of CrSBr
items.abstract: We present a systematic study of the effects of chlorine substitution on the magneto-optical properties of the van der Waals layered semiconductor CrSBr. Our study shows that even at substitution level of $x=56\%$ the $\mathrm{CrSBr_{1-x}Cl_{x}}$ material exhibits qualitatively the same clear magneto-optical coupling that was observed in pure CrSBr crystals. The values of the relevant parameters are shown to vary smoothly across different substitution levels, thus offering promising tunability for this family of 2D magnetic materials.

items.abstract: Two dimensional Janus semiconductors integrating spin-valley coupling, piezoelectricity, and tunable optical responses offer a platform for multifunctional nanodevices. Here, first-principles calculations reveal complementary composition and strain effects in CrSiCN4 and CrGeCN4 monolayers. Both are found to be nonmagnetic direct-gap semiconductors, with gaps of 1.23 and 1.09 eV using the Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof functional including spin-orbit coupling, respectively. Opposite out-of-plane spin character and Berry curvature emerge at K and K'. items.abstract: Analog transistor sizing, finding design parameters that simultaneously satisfy multiple performance specifications, is a labor-intensive bottleneck in circuit design. To support analog circuit experts, various automation methods have been proposed, including Bayesian optimization (BO), reinforcement learning (RL), and others. Yet existing methods are oblivious to the topological structure of a feasible design space, which can fragment into disconnected regions due to operating-regime transitions, conflicting specification trade-offs, and nonconvex device physics. This topological blindness causes the optimizer to converge within a single feasible region while missing others that may contain superior designs. items.title: Band Tail States: Speed Bump or End of the Road for Two-Dimensional Semiconductors?
items.abstract: We propose that the path to realizing the full potential of two-dimensional (2D) electronics lies in understanding and mastering their energy band tail states (BTS). Unlike silicon, which benefits from sharp band edges (Urbach energy $E_\rm U$ ~ 10 meV), today's monolayer 2D semiconductors have rough band edges ($E_\rm U$ ~ 100 meV) caused by spatial potential inhomogeneity. Comparing a physics-based electrical model to experiments, we demonstrate that BTS cause reduced effective mobility and "slow" transistor turn-on with excessive gate voltage in monolayer 2D transistors, which sets a fundamental limit for their energy-efficient operation. We also show that BTS effects in 2D transistors could be mitigated with higher gate capacitance, with strain engineering, and by using bilayer instead of monolayer 2D channels, as long as $E_\rm U$ is reduced below ~ 50 meV. items.title: Quantum-vortex excitons beyond band topology
items.abstract: Optically exciting a typical low-dimensional semiconductor produces a nodeless \(s\)-type exciton as its lowest-energy bound state. Here, we explain how Coulomb phase matching stabilises a quantum-vortex exciton as the lowest bound state in flat Chern bands. Using a prototypical Yin--Yang kagome lattice, we demonstrate that increasing the spin--orbit coupling drives a transition of the lowest exciton from a quantum-vortex state to a zero-winding state, while leaving the band Chern numbers unchanged. We trace this behaviour to a gauge-invariant combination of exciton phase differences and Bloch-overlap phases that can reduce the Coulomb energy. By comparing states with identical wavefunction amplitudes, we isolate this phase contribution and show that it is sufficient to drive the reversal in exciton ordering. items.title: Surface Physics of Low-Dimensional Pnictogen Chalcohalides and Its Impact on Photovoltaic Technologies
items.abstract: Low-dimensional pnictogen chalcohalides (MChX; M = Bi, Sb; Ch = S, Se; X = I, Br) are promising non-toxic semiconductors for solar energy conversion, yet the power conversion efficiencies of MChX solar cells remain below 10%, far from their Shockley-Queisser limit of $\sim$30%. Efficient charge extraction depends critically on the band-edge alignment between the absorber and the charge-selective contacts, which is a surface property. Here, we combine first-principles calculations with device-level modelling to investigate the surface energetics and band alignments across the MChX family. An exhaustive sampling of crystal orientations, including low-symmetry facets, identifies the (011) and (010) surfaces as the most stable terminations in all eight compounds. items.title: Efficient Patch-Based Anomaly Detection Fused with Diffusion Driven Generative Modeling for Semiconductor Wafer Bin Map Open Set Anomaly Detection
items.abstract: Spatial defect signatures on wafer bin maps (WBMs) trace yield loss to specific process faults, yet supervised classifiers recognize only the defect types seen during training, and one-class detectors built on a single mechanism tend to capture either local structural deviations or global distributional violations, but rarely both. items.title: Ambipolar metal-insulator transition in bilayer MoSe2
items.abstract: When Coulomb interactions dominate kinetic energy, dilute two-dimensional carriers form a Wigner solid. Both its melting and disorder-driven localization can drive density-tuned metal-insulator transitions, but their relative roles and interplay have been debated for decades. Atomically thin semiconductors offer a new test because transport and scanning tunneling microscopy can probe the same material, yet poor contacts impede transport where correlations are strongest. Here we introduce contact-free radio-frequency reflectometry that senses sheet resistance through capacitive gate coupling. It resolves the electron and previously inaccessible hole transitions in the same bilayer MoSe2 device, whose carriers share disorder but not mass. items.title: MarketRank: ranking stocks by the stationary probabilities of a Markov chain over estimated money flows, with a topological landscape view
items.abstract: Every trading day, money leaves some stocks and moves into others. MarketRank asks where that money concentrates and how the concentration shifts over time. It treats the market as a Markov chain whose states are stocks. The chance of moving from one stock to another is the share of the first stock's outgoing dollars that goes to the second, and a stock's MarketRank score is its long run (stationary) probability in that chain, computed by damped power iteration on a sparse transition matrix. PageRank ranks web pages with the same idea, using links instead of dollars. Who sold what to buy what is not public, so the flows are estimated from daily prices and volumes with a correlation tilted gravity model, in a deterministic parallel C++ engine. items.title: Superconducting edge contact to a buried Ge quantum well
items.abstract: Semiconductor-superconductor hybrid systems form the basis for a broad range of quantum phenomena, such as Andreev bound states, topological superconductivity, and hybrid quantum Hall states. Here, we address this problem with an edge-contact approach that combines anisotropic dry etching to access the quantum well followed by wet etching for interface preparation. items.title: Squeezed light from a semiconductor amplifier
items.abstract: The possibility of generating light in a squeezed quantum state during saturated light amplification in a semiconductor amplifier is theoretically analyzed. Due to four-wave mixing process during amplification, weak components of the spontaneous emission of the medium with symmetric frequency shifts relative to the strong amplified wave acquire the quantum properties of two-mode squeezed light. The squeezing of quadrature components occurs in the range of frequency shifts of several GHz ($\sim$ the inverse relaxation time of the charge carrier density) and can reach 10 dB or more under optimal conditions. The formation of a two-mode squeezing phase facilitates the observation of the squeezing effect, in which a strong wave, playing the role of a local wave, exhibits quadrature noise suppression without additional homodyne detection.

items.title: Two-exciton bound states in the Merrifield exciton model
items.abstract: Understanding the formation and dynamics of two-exciton bound states (BSs) is crucial for harnessing multi-exciton phenomena and designing next-generation organic semiconductor materials. While various mechanisms such as intermolecular exciton-exciton interactions or multi-level intramolecular configurations can generate these BSs, a fundamental understanding of their underlying lattice dynamics remains a key challenge. Within this context, the Merrifield exciton model stands out as a premier framework for capturing the intricate quantum mixing between single-site doubly-excited states and two-particle scattering continuum. In this work, by constructing a set of exact two-exciton Bloch states and applying a plane-wave ansatz to treat the resulting inhomogeneous tridiagonal matrices, we provide a complete, rigorous solution to the two-exciton problem in a finite-size Merrifield chain. We...

items.title: Sparse qubit operation in a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array
items.abstract: Fault-tolerant quantum computation requires increasing the qubit count while maintaining high performance and connectivity. Semiconductor qubits have demonstrated high-fidelity operation, but growing the system size at sufficient connectivity remains challenging, such that scaling mainly occurred in one spatial direction to preserve access for control lines in the other. Here, we realise an approach that relaxes the requirements on fabrication and demonstrate a 6$\times$6 quantum dot array, defined by a shared barrier gate and individual plunger gates. The quantum dots are tuned through coherent spin shuttling over distances up to 5.2um into a sparse configuration of 10 simultaneously operated qubits, leaving space for shuttling connections. We reduce crosstalk by 42$\times$ in this separated regime, enabling high-fidelity simultaneous single-qubit control, while control-Z operations can...

items.title: CacheFit: The Rising Cost of Cache Replacement and Constraint-Driven Redesign of Last-Level Cache Replacement Policies
items.abstract: The latency, power, and area costs of LLC replacement remain poorly explored not because simulators cannot be instrumented--event counters feeding a power model are routine--but because no cost model takes a replacement policy as input. CACTI and McPAT price regular structures, a cache or a core, not the small, oddly shaped arrays and dependent logic a policy is made of, and no event count reveals a victim-selection path's logic depth. Without a model, cost has never been an objective a policy search could optimize. In practice, a policy is first selected in simulation for its IPC, and its cost is reduced later in RTL, after the algorithm is fixed. Cost thus enters the design too late to shape it. This paper asks what happens when cost is present from the start. We build CacheFit, the first policy-design loop for LLC replacement with circuit-level cost inside the search objective. CacheF...

Each task supplies a textual device specification and contour coordinates. An agent generates typed polygon and path operations rendered to GDSII. items.title: Hall conductance of dilute electrolytes from odd stochastic density functional theory
items.abstract: Electrolytes under an external magnetic field exhibit a Hall conductivity, much like metals and semiconductors. However, existing theories fail to quantitatively account for their measured Hall conductivities. To make progress toward such a theory, we develop a stochastic density functional framework for electrolytes in a magnetic field. This framework, which we dub odd SDFT, extends the celebrated stochastic density functional theory (SDFT) to incorporate transverse mobilities and chiral time-correlated noise. Using this framework, we calculate the Hall conductivity in the absence of hydrodynamic solvent effects through three approaches: (i) direct response, (ii) Green-Kubo relation, and (iii) a hybrid fluctuation-dissipation relation. items.abstract: Annealing a semiconductor makes its vacancies mobile; they aggregate into multi-vacancy complexes that often carry spin. Such centres are a magnetic-noise source for any spin qubit among them, in silicon and silicon carbide as well as in diamond, and they are accordingly blamed for NV-decoherence in irradiated and implanted diamond, with two coherence records credited to removing them. Cluster-correlation-expansion simulations driven by published electron-paramagnetic-resonance parameters invert that attribution. At a fixed paramagnetic spin density a multi-vacancy bath gives a Hahn-echo coherence time 3.1-7.1 times longer than a bath of isolated negative vacancies, over three decades of concentration. We derive the corresponding self-energy diagrams, which depend on the chemical potential and temperature, and evaluate them from first principles for the two polar semiconductors LiF and KTaO$_3$. In both materials, the two interaction channels renormalize the phonon spectrum in qualitatively distinct ways. items.abstract: The rapid advancement of deep learning has presented significant energy efficiency challenges to the conventional von Neumann architecture. In-memory computing (IMC) architectures based on emerging non-volatile memory (eNVM) are widely regarded as a promising solution for accelerating neural network training due to their high parallelism and low power consumption. However, the intrinsic non-idealities of eNVM devices can cause conductance updates to deviate from target values, thereby limiting the performance of on-chip training. To address this challenge, this paper presents a Non-ideality Optimized eNVM Accelerator (NOVA) architecture for on-chip training. Specifically, we first fabricate a two-dimensional (2D) ferroelectric field-effect transistor (FeFET) and develop a conductance modulation behavioral model calibrated with experimental data. Building upon this device model, we propos...

items.title: Compact Modeling of Oxide-Semiconductor, 2D Material, Carbon Nanotube, and Cryogenic Transistors with Experiment Verification
items.abstract: This paper presents a unified compact model for emerging transistor technologies, including oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (OSFETs), 2D material FETs (2DFETs), carbon nanotube FETs (CNFETs), and cryogenic MOSFETs. A unified charge-density formulation is developed to account for quantum confinement, trap charges, and band-tail states in channel charge calculations. A physics-based transport model is introduced to seamlessly capture carrier transport from the long-channel diffusive regime to the short-channel ballistic limit. Scaling models are incorporated to accurately describe 2D electrostatic effects. Cryogenic operation is modeled through the inclusion of band-tail states and temperature-dependent mobility and threshold voltage. The proposed model is validated against experimental data from the fabricated OSFETs with multiple channel lengths and published measurements of...

items.title: Optically Coupled Noise Spectroscopy Quantifies Defect Passivation in Monolayer MoS2 FETs
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide monolayers are promising materials for electronic and photonic applications, yet the performance of chemical vapour deposition grown samples is severely limited by native sulphur vacancies that introduce mid-gap trap states, degrade carrier mobility, and elevate electrical noise. Here we investigate octanethiol passivation of sulphur vacancies in monolayer MoS2 field effect transistors, combining x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, photoluminescence, and Raman scattering with electrical transport and optically coupled low-frequency noise spectroscopy. Thiol treatment reduces the sulphur vacancy concentration from 7% to 4%, reducing the free electron density. Electrically, it increases the device resistance 35-fold while restoring gate switching with an on/off ratio of 10^4 and improving field-effect mobility from 1 to 5 cm^2/Vs. Low frequency noise spectrosc...

items.title: On-chip nanoplasma for adaptive electromagnetic protection
items.abstract: Over the past decade, semiconductor diodes have served as the primary switching elements in adaptive electromagnetic (EM) protection, yet their performance has been compromised by parasitic effects and thermal accumulation, rendering them inadequate against the rapidly evolving landscape of high-power microwave (HPM) threats. Here we show that on-chip nanoplasma switches (NPMS), composed of gallium nitride electrodes on silicon carbide substrates, exhibit superior radio frequency (RF) and thermal characteristics, positioning them as ideal field-driven switches in RF front-end protectors. By integrating NPMS into metasurfaces, antennas and circuit limiters, we achieve an adaptive response that ensures low-loss transmission for normal signals and high shielding against HPMs, while offering extended operating bandwidth and substantially higher tolerance than conventional solid-state devices...

items.title: Inverse-Designed High-Q/V Silicon Nitride Photonic Crystal Cavities for Second- and Third-Harmonic Generation
items.abstract: SiN photonic crystal (PhC) cavities are promising platforms for nonlinear and quantum photonics because of their wide transparency window, CMOS compatibility, and negligible two-photon absorption. However, realizing high-Q/V cavities remains challenging because of the relatively low refractive index of SiN. Here, we employ inverse design to optimize a two-dimensional SiN PhC cavity and experimentally demonstrate a quality factor of approximately 80,000, the highest reported for a near-stoichiometric SiN 2D PhC cavity. Furthermore, both second- and third-harmonic generation are observed from the same cavity, providing experimental evidence of strong optical confinement and large Q/V. Our results establish inverse-designed SiN PhC cavities as a promising platform for nonlinear photonics and future heterogeneous integrated photonic devices.

items.title: Approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser for reducing energy consumption
items.abstract: Photonic reservoir computing is a promising physical machine-learning approach for time-series prediction. Quantization of the reservoir response signal is an important consideration in the implementation of photonic reservoir computing, and the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency need to be optimized to achieve high prediction performance and low energy consumption. However, few studies have investigated the effects of the number of quantization bits and sampling frequency on both prediction performance and energy consumption. In this study, we introduce the concept of approximate reservoir computing with a semiconductor laser by quantizing the reservoir node states and output weights. We numerically evaluate the performance of a chaotic time-series prediction task and estimate the energy consumption per sample using a component-level model. By optimizing the number of qu...

items.title: Photon-conserving Raman soliton attractors in focusing and defocusing Kerr media
items.abstract: The sign of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient has long been regarded as irrelevant to the direction of the Raman-induced soliton self-frequency shift. Yet the standard generalized nonlinear Schrödinger equation (GNLSE) predicts a frequency shift that depends on the sign of the nonlinearity, which leads to an unphysical blue shift in the defocusing case. We resolve this inconsistency by deriving the time-domain form of the photon-conserving GNLSE (pcGNLSE) from its established frequency-domain counterpart. The derivation reveals that photon-number conservation imposes two sign modifications relative to the standard GNLSE: the Raman-shift coefficient acquires the absolute value of the Kerr nonlinear coefficient in place of its signed counterpart, and the self-steepening-Raman dissipation term likewise carries an absolute-value prefactor rather than a signed one. These two modifications jointl...

items.title: Graph-Based Kirchhoff Modeling of Non-Ohmic Electron Transport in Self-Assembled Nanonecklace Networks
items.abstract: Gold nanonecklace networks exhibit non-Ohmic current--voltage I-V characteristics with a sharp conduction threshold, making them promising for sensing and transistor-like devices. However, their conduction has been understood largely empirically, because experiments cannot see how conduction evolves inside the network. To address this, we develop a graph-based Kirchhoff modeling framework that resolves these internal processes, tracking the potential and current of every junction. Although every active element conducts linearly, the model reproduces the non-Ohmic response $I \propto (V-V_T)^ζ$. It also captures the experimentally observed effects of junction properties, network density, and voids, which lends confidence to its predicted internal states. These states show that the non-Ohmic response emerges from voltage-driven percolation. Conduction is governed by how junctions are conne...

items.title: Complex frequency-dependent quadrature squeezing in semiconductor lasers
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive study of quadrature squeezing in a quantum well laser based on a fully quantum Langevin approach. We compute the frequency-resolved squeezing map of the laser field and identify optimal squeezing curves, revealing, for the first time to our knowledge, both frequency-dependent squeezing and complex or hidden squeezing in a semiconductor laser. We further analyse the role of the linewidth enhancement factor (alpha-factor) in the emergence of these features. Our results establish semiconductor lasers as a platform for the generation of non-classical light and open new perspectives for their application in quantum communication and sensing.

items.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
items.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. This establishes impurities as tomographic probes for band structure...

items.title: Nanoscopic Multiplexing Optical Data Storage via Chip Fabrication
items.abstract: The accelerating growth of global data demands storage technologies combining high capacity, long lifetime and low energy consumption. Optical storage is attractive for archival applications, but conventional optical writing is constrained by diffraction-limited resolution and scalability, while thermal accumulation limits high-speed writing. Here we shift optical data writing from a serial optical process to a fabrication-defined process, in which lithographic masks govern where material modification occurs. Using patterned resist masks and ion implantation, we create fluorescent information voxels with nanoscale control over millimeter-scale areas. The platform supports multilevel and multidimensional encoding by independently encoding information in fluorescence intensity and wavelength. A machine-learning-assisted super-resolution reconstruction protocol is developed to recover infor...

items.title: Absorption and Phase-Contrast Microtomography Using Direct X-Ray Detection With Commercial Off-The-Shelf CMOS Sensors
items.abstract: This work presents high-resolution X-ray microtomography based on commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) CMOS image sensors as direct detectors. The system uses a microfocus X-ray source in cone-beam geometry, enabling both absorption-contrast imaging, thanks to the sensor s intrinsic resolution, and phase-contrast imaging, by adjusting the object-to-sensor distance. A dynamic flat-field correction algorithm mitigates radiation-induced sensor degradation during long acquisitions. The setup provides voxel sizes from 3.9 microns to 5.2 microns, with an effective spatial resolution (FWHM) as fine as 9.6 microns in magnified phase-contrast mode (1.33x) and 21 microns in non-magnified absorption-contrast mode. Phase contrast enhances visualization of soft tissue boundaries that are difficult to visualize using absorption-contrast imaging in the same experimental configuration.

items.title: Anharmonic Quantum Transport Analysis of Thermal Transport Anomalies in Ultrathin Silicon Nanowires
items.abstract: Thermal transport in low-dimensional semiconductors is important for nanoelectronics, quantum devices, and thermoelectrics. Recent molecular dynamics (MD) studies reveal a nonmonotonic diameter dependence of thermal conductivity in ultrathin silicon nanowires (NWs), but classical MD is limited at low temperatures and under strong confinement. Here, we investigate this anomaly using anharmonic non-equilibrium Green's function (NEGF) simulations combined with density functional theory-trained neuroevolution potentials. All transport results are expressed as effective thermal conductivities ($κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$) for NW devices with a finite channel length of $L=10$ nm. At 300 K, $κ_{\mathrm{eff}}$ decreases with diameter to minima at 6.24 and 5.50 nm for [001]- and [110]-oriented NWs, respectively. At 10 K, the corresponding minima occur at 7.33 and 5.50 nm. items.title: Predictive Software Scheduling as an Early-Warning Hint Layer for Optical Engine Thermal Drift in Heterogeneous SoIC Packaging
items.abstract: As semiconductor scaling approaches the A16 / 2 nm node, the integration of co-packaged optics (CPO) through TSMC's Compact Universal Photonic Engine (COUPE) architecture introduces critical thermal-optical coupling challenges. Micro-ring resonators embedded in the Photonic Integrated Circuit (PIC) layer are highly sensitive to temperature, with a wafer-level center wavelength deviation of merely +/-1.7 nm across a 300 mm wafer representing the platform's manufacturing control limit. To address this, we propose XRM-SSD V24, a physics-aware scheduling layer that models inference-load density 20-50 ms before execution and issues early-warning hints to the COUPE bias-control firmware, enabling pre-emptive thermal compensation. Simulation-based validation on a software emulation platform (physical characterization pending TSMC tape-out) over 90,000 inference steps yields a simulator-internal...

items.title: Speed Kills: Exploring Confused Deputy Attacks Through Edge AI Accelerators
items.abstract: AI Accelerators (AIAs) are specialized hardware, such as Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), that enable optimal and efficient execution of AI applications and on-device inference. The growing demand for AI applications has led to the widespread adoption of AIAs on edge and embedded devices. Unlike applications, AIAs are not bound by Operating System (OS) restrictions and have limited visibility into Application Processor (AP) security mechanisms (e.g., kernel versus application memory and process isolation). This semantic gap can lead to confused deputy vulnerabilities, where an AIA can be tricked by a malicious application into performing privileged operations on its behalf. In this paper, we conduct the first in-depth study of Confused Deputy Attacks (CDAs) using AIAs. We design DeputyHunt, a Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted framework to extract CDA-relevant information for a given AIA...

items.title: Energy Consumption in Next Generation Radio Access Networks
items.abstract: Historically, in macro-cell-based networks, the radio access network (RAN) portion accounts for the largest share of energy consumption in mobile networks. With greater densification, the transition to small cells and increased virtualization of the radio processing functions, the relative energy use of the different network segments is changing. At the same time, open radio access networks (O-RAN) have emerged as a promising approach to support this evolution through open interfaces that enable a multi-vendor environment, support for hierarchical intelligent controls, and simplified, cost-effective radio units that facilitate large-scale deployments. This paper examines the impact of these changes on energy consumption in next-generation RAN architectures through transaction-based energy models. Transaction-based network energy models were developed in 2009 to understand the evolution o...

items.title: Joint Architecture-Token-Bitwidth Multi-Axis Optimization of Vision Transformers for Semiconductor IC Packaging
items.abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have achieved strong performance in visual recognition, yet their deployment in resource-constrained industrial environments remains limited. The main challenges are their high computational cost, memory requirements, and energy consumption. While individual efficiency techniques such as neural architecture search (NAS), token compression, and low-precision inference have been extensively studied, most prior work targets only a single optimization axis, limiting overall deployment gains while preserving accuracy. In this paper, we present one of the first holistic frameworks that jointly optimizes three complementary axes: architecture, token, and bit-width. Specifically, the framework identifies compact backbones via Neural Architecture Search (AutoFormer), reduces information processing via token merging (ToMe), and accelerates per-operation execution via fp1...

items.title: Proximitized Topological Insulator Charge Island Fabricated via In Situ Multi-Angle Stencil Lithography
items.abstract: Hybrid superconductor-topological insulator (TI) nanostructures constitute a promising material platform for exploring proximity-induced superconductivity in systems with topologically protected surface states. A key obstacle has been the realization of clean and well-controlled superconductor-TI interfaces, as TI surfaces rapidly degrade under ambient conditions. Here, we introduce a fully in situ, multi-angle stencil lithography technique that enables the fabrication of proximitized charge islands in TIs. The approach combines selective area growth of (Bi,Sb)$_2$Te$_3$ nanoribbons with angle-controlled deposition of diffusion barriers, superconducting Al, and ultrathin oxide tunnel barriers, allowing scalable fabrication of hybrid nanostructures without post-growth processing.
